text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(There might be tons of Umamusume<n>out there who
are stronger than me...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(And there might be tons of<n>Umamusume whose
running is even<n>more eye-catching than mine...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I know that nobody's morepassionate about running than I am!Because...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I love running! I really love it! I love itmore than the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I... I did it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That was some nice running.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And you may have beat me with that<n>running! But
don't go thinking I'm<n>just gonna throw in the
towel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're mine next time. This is just<n>the beginning of
our rivalry, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heh. Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But first, some praise. You ran<n>phenomenally.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And it looks like the crowd agrees.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: INEEES! INEEES! INEEES! INEEES!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
INEEES! INEEES! INEEES! INEEES!<n>INEEES!
INEEES!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Ahaha! C'mon everyone,<n>you're going
overboard here... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your support!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone, did your dreams<n>come true today?
As for me...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I feel like all my dreams just came<n>true at once!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I had so much fun. Every second I<n>spent running
was just... bliss.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Thank you, thank you,<n>thank you!
